title: Israeli Lawmakers Demanded Better PR to Conceal Gaza Famine. Google Obliged.
author: Lee Fang
content:

_Investigation published in partnership with Drop Site News._  
  
On March 2, 2025, hours after the Israeli government
[announced](https://substack.com/redirect/bd29e935-285b-46a9-886e-84f235eacbc7?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
the blockade of all food, medicine, fuel, and other humanitarian supplies from
entering Gaza, lawmakers in Jerusalem demanded answers--not on the devastating
human toll of such a decision, but on how Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's
office was preparing to handle the public relations fallout.

"I began with the example of the cessation of humanitarian aid--did you
prepare for this thing this morning?" asked Knesset member Moshe Tur-Paz, the
chair of a subcommittee on Foreign Affairs in Israel's parliament.  
  
Avichai Edrei, a spokesperson for the Israel Defense Forces who was asked the
same question later in the hearing, assured the legislators work was underway,
stating, "We could also decide to launch a digital campaign in this context,
to explain that there is no hunger and present the data."

Publicly available government contracts show that Israel's advertising bureau,
which reports to the prime minister's office, has since embarked on a mass
advertising and public messaging effort to conceal the hunger crisis. The push
includes the use of [American
influencers](https://substack.com/redirect/01ed7a89-90fd-4ad5-aeb2-811526848ebe?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
widely reported on last month. It also includes a high-dollar spending spree
on paid advertising, yielding tens of millions for Google, YouTube, X, Meta,
and other tech platforms.

"There is food in Gaza. Any other claim is a lie," asserted a propaganda video
[published](https://substack.com/redirect/47b537d8-ef8d-4ac6-b1e9-25cabf06f206?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
by Israel's foreign ministry to Google's YouTube video sharing platform in
late August and viewed more than 6 million times.  
  
Much of the video's reach results from an
[ad](https://substack.com/redirect/824e6f31-9ce9-437a-aa02-a7122ebc77a9?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
placed during an ongoing and previously unreported [$45
million](https://substack.com/redirect/d878da4e-764d-4821-9797-c171c86fae18?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
(NIS 150 million) advertising campaign initiated between Google and
Netanyahu's office in late June. The contract--which is with both YouTube and
Google's advertising campaign management platform, Display & Video 360--
explicitly characterizes the ad campaign as _hasbara_ , a Hebrew word whose
meaning is somewhere between public relations and propaganda.

screenshot from the Israeli
government[disclosure](https://substack.com/redirect/6bbc9dc2-a4e1-4f3e-9c19-bffba1692f8f?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
of the roughly $45 million contract between Israel's government advertising
bureau (Lapam) and Google's Display & Video and YouTube advertising platforms.
Both campaigns are listed as spanning June 17 to December 31, 2025._

Records show that the Israeli government similarly spent $3 million (NIS 10
million) for an advertising campaign with X. The French and Israeli
advertising platform
[Outbrain/Teads](https://substack.com/redirect/9b22d504-38d1-415b-b033-ec27b642e31a?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
is also set to receive roughly $2.1 million (NIS 7 million).

The ads have aired in response to increasing global outcry over the
deteriorating situation in Gaza. In August, the UN formally declared a famine
in Gaza governorate, which includes Gaza City. The Integrated Food Security
Phase Classification (IPC), the leading global authority on food security,
projected the threshold for famine would be crossed in Deir al-Balah and Khan
Younis in the coming weeks, stating "this Famine is entirely man-made, it can
be halted and reversed."  
  
The UN aid coordination office OCHA [further
warned](https://substack.com/redirect/61621bf8-78e7-4108-92c7-842a1646efc5?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
on Friday of "a descent into a massive famine" in the Gaza Strip.

At least 367 Palestinians, including 131 children, have died as a result of
hunger and malnutrition since the war began, according to the health ministry
in Gaza.

The existence of an Israeli Google ads campaign to discredit the UN's primary
aid agency for Palestinian refugees, UNRWA, was similarly
[reported](https://substack.com/redirect/fb97ec8c-1d18-4648-8202-5be87e594f04?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
by WIRED last year. Hadas Maimon, head of public awareness for Israel's
diaspora ministry, stated during the March 2 Knesset hearing that, "For almost
a year now, we have been leading a major campaign on the issue of UNRWA."

Other Israeli government ads on Google's platforms
[accused](https://substack.com/redirect/c8888eb8-286d-4296-9224-a5f4d77ed356?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
the United Nations of "deliberate sabotage" of aid delivery into Gaza and
[promoted](https://substack.com/redirect/1c64dac8-82b1-4c23-b7a9-4a2ca01a62db?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, which is backed by Israel, the U.S., and
unnamed European countries. One campaign
[promoted](https://substack.com/redirect/af133046-ea39-4bd5-8be2-5666d5c9b7a0?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
prosecution of the militant group Hamas, which governs the Gaza Strip, for
debunked allegations of mass sexual violence as a result of a [controversial
report](https://substack.com/redirect/dfa90148-6228-4eb6-9d8c-30b50f361bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
published by the Israeli advocacy group Dinah Project.  
  
Despite the denial about the famine, prominent Israeli government voices have
championed the effort to cut off food and water to Gazans as a strategy for
inducing mass migration out of the territory. "In my opinion, you can besiege
them," said Bezalel Smotrich, the Israeli Finance Ministry and a coalition
partner to Netantayu's government, according to Channel 12. "No water, no
electricity, they can die of hunger or surrender," Smotrich
[said](https://substack.com/redirect/cea9f5a7-8cd8-43ab-
bd0d-3c76f353de1e?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw).

Amichay Eliyahu, the Knesset member who leads the Heritage Ministry in
Netanyahu's government, has similarly
[called](https://substack.com/redirect/70a0adfb-a5a3-4e29-a71e-140a8bdc70b2?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw)
for starving the Palestinian population of Gaza. "There is no nation that
feeds its enemies," Eliyahu said during a radio interview in July. In May, the
minister argued the Palestinians "need to starve" and
[added](https://substack.com/redirect/5bb57012-171c-4c92-96bb-2c79d5cf25d6?j=eyJ1IjoiY3lqaCJ9.6_rLreYMLP3eANK_wbJdSPGnUEirmGlX9L_LxODSZcw),
"If there are civilians who fear for their lives, they should go through the
emigration plan."
